bold.$description: Solid blue fill for informational chips and secondary category tags, not links (use text.link).
Solid brand-violet fill for brand moments and onboarding hero panels, not primary CTAs (use interactive.primary).

subtle.$description: Low emphasis brand fill, for tinted brand panels.

bold.$description: Solid coral fill for decorative emphasis, category tags, and illustration accents, not errors or warnings.
Solid green fill for streak counters, progress markers, and positive stat chips, not validation success (use feedback.success.bold).

subtle.$description: Low emphasis green fill, for tinted background behind a green stat or chip.

bold.$description: Solid magenta accent fill, for decorative category tags.

floating.$description: Translucent frosted-glass fill for dropdowns, tooltips, and popovers floating above content.

input.$description: Fill for text inputs, textareas, and search fields at rest, not read-only surfaces (use background.surface).

inverse.$description: Dark block for tooltips, toasts, and snackbars on light backgrounds, not the page background.

page.$description: Base background for every screen; not for cards, sheets, or modals, which use background.surface instead.

scrim.$description: Semi-transparent overlay behind modals, dialogs, and bottom sheets, always paired with a foreground surface on top.

stacking.$description: Additive white layer giving toasts and floating notifications subtle lift above dark surfaces.

surface.$description: Elevated fill for cards, sheets, modals, dropdowns, chat bubbles, and toasts; not the page-level background.

default.$description: Standard edge for card outlines, dividers, and resting input borders, not selected-element borders.

error.$description: Edge for text fields and selects that failed validation, paired with text.error for the message underneath.

focus.$description: Keyboard focus ring for the visible focus indicator; pair with the heavy 2px stroke and never remove without a replacement.

selected.$description: Edge for selected cards, active tabs, and chosen answer options, paired with highlight.surface as the fill.

strong.$description: Higher-contrast edge for dividers, table rules, and busy surfaces, not default card outlines (use border.default).

success.$description: Validated input edge, for fields confirmed correct.

bold.$description: Solid fill for incorrect-answer banners and failed-validation summaries, not destructive buttons (use interactive.destructive).

subtle.$description: Tinted error background, for the panel behind a wrong result.

bold.$description: Solid fill for correct-answer banners and completion states, not decorative green accents (use accent.green.bold).

subtle.$description: Tinted success background, for the panel behind a correct result.

border.$description: Edge that pairs with highlight.surface; never used alone.

surface.$description: Fill for selected cards, active tabs, and the answer a student picked, not primary CTAs (use interactive.primary).

destructive.$description: Fill for irreversible destructive actions like delete, remove, or block, not for validation errors.

destructiveHover.$description: Hover state of interactive.destructive, for pointer hover on delete and remove buttons.

disabled.$description: Fill for disabled buttons, toggles, and sliders signaling an unavailable control, not active secondary buttons.

onDestructive.$description: Text and icons on interactive.destructive fills; must contrast at least 4.5:1 against it.

onPrimary.$description: Text and icons on interactive.primary fills; must contrast at least 4.5:1 against it.

onSecondary.$description: Text and icons on interactive.secondary fills, such as secondary button labels, toggle text, and filter chips.

pressed.$description: Press-state overlay for primary buttons and elements on light or vivid fills, not dark surfaces (use interactive.pressedInverse there).

pressedInverse.$description: Press-state overlay for secondary buttons, icon buttons, and cards on dark surfaces, not light or vivid fills.

primary.$description: Main CTA fill for buttons like Continue, Check, or Start practice, and progress bar fills; limit to one per screen.

primaryActive.$description: Pressed state of interactive.primary, for the moment of click or tap on a primary button.

primaryHover.$description: Hover state of interactive.primary, for pointer hover on primary buttons.

secondary.$description: Supporting-action fill for Skip, Cancel, filter chips, outlined buttons, and toggles, not the primary CTA.

secondaryHover.$description: Hover state of interactive.secondary, for pointer hover on secondary buttons, chips and toggles.

eyes.$description: Homie eye whites, for mascot illustration only.

primary.$description: Homie's signature violet, used for mascot illustrations and mascot-hero moments only, not buttons, links, PRO badges, or selected states.

pupils.$description: Homie pupils, for mascot illustration only.

accent.$description: Alias of pro.bold for PRO badges and upgrade prompts, kept for legacy naming.

bold.$description: Solid fill for PRO badges and upgrade banners, not warnings (use text.warning).

disabled.$description: Low-contrast text for disabled controls and empty-field placeholders, not secondary labels or metadata.

error.$description: Validation message text for the line under a failed field, not destructive button labels.

inverse.$description: Dark text for use on background.inverse and bright accent fills, not on the dark page background.

link.$description: Inline hyperlink text for linked body copy and "Learn more" links only, not buttons, nav items, or non-clickable accent text.

linkHover.$description: Hover state of text.link, for pointer hover on inline hyperlinks.

onAccent.$description: Text on any accent.*.bold fill; must contrast at least 4.5:1 against it.

primary.$description: Highest-contrast text for headlines, body copy, titles, and card labels; the default choice when unsure.

secondary.$description: Reduced-emphasis text for subtitles, captions, timestamps, and metadata, not primary headlines or disabled labels.

success.$description: Confirmation text for messages like "Correct," not for use as a fill (use feedback.success.bold).

tertiary.$description: Lowest-emphasis text for timestamps, counts, and inline hints, never anything a student must read to proceed.

warning.$description: Caution text, for limits, expiry notices, "one attempt left".

idle.$description: Mic fill before the student starts speaking. Same value as interactive.secondary (color/alpha/light-10), aliased directly to the primitive rather than through that token, matching how every other semantic color in this file references its primitive.

listening.$description: Mic fill while actively recording the student's answer. Matches the magenta glow already visible in the beta screens. PAIR: voice.onListening for the waveform mark on top.

onListening.$description: Waveform mark drawn on top of voice.listening.

processing.$description: Mic fill during the STT + judge wait (the brief's <4s window). Not tappable during this state. Aliased to color/alpha/light-18, the same primitive as interactive.pressed and interactive.secondaryHover, one step up from voice.idle's light-10 so the two no longer read as identical.

l.$description: Largest display size, for hero numbers and level-up moments.

m.$description: Large display size, for prominent standalone numerals or short hero text.

s.$description: Smallest display size, for secondary hero text below a Display L or M element.

xl.$description: Largest headline size, for a screen's primary title.

l.$description: Large headline size, for section or screen titles below Headline XL.

m.$description: Medium headline size, for card titles and sub-section headers.

s.$description: Small headline size, for minor headers and prompt titles.

bold.$description: Extra-small bold headline, for compact emphasized headers, e.g. list group titles.

regular.$description: Extra-small regular headline, for compact non-emphasized headers.

bold.$description: Smallest bold headline, for dense emphasized labels above body copy.

regular.$description: Smallest regular headline, for dense non-emphasized labels above body copy.

bold.$description: Medium bold body text, for emphasized paragraph or list copy.

regular.$description: Medium regular body text, the default for paragraph copy.

bold.$description: Small bold body text, for emphasized supporting copy.

regular.$description: Small regular body text, for supporting copy and secondary descriptions.

bold.$description: Medium bold caption, for emphasized helper text and metadata.

regular.$description: Medium regular caption, for helper text, timestamps, and metadata.

bold.$description: Smallest bold caption, for emphasized micro-labels.

regular.$description: Smallest regular caption, for micro-labels and fine print.
